purpose: Freeze a target-blind public-source metadata audit, direct-endpoint contract, alias/overlap rules, and whole-group split algorithm for CP10.1-CP10.2. Builder access remains zero-row; a separately disclosed interactive web-search excerpt incident is not concealed.

fact_provenance_contract.claim_limit: The fact binding detects local factual-field mutation but does not prove that mutable remote pages retain their observed content.

xgap_redshift_reconciliation.required_resolution: Reconcile the retrievable canonical 49-object manifest against the 2024 primary selection and actual-range statements before aliases, eligibility, or splits are frozen.

mass_scope.rule: A source may document membership in the approximate group-scale interval, but source-inferred hydrostatic, lensing, dynamical, richness, luminosity-scaling, or count-rate-scaling mass may not be loaded as a response or candidate input.

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The X-GAP project page documents a 49-group sample selected with R500 below 15 arcmin, redshift below 0.05, and more than eight optical members, spanning 1e13 < M500 < 1e14 solar masses; it reports that 38 groups had not previously been observed by modern X-ray satellites.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: official project page final-sample criteria and attachment table

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The legacy project page names the FITS attachment, but the attachment URL currently redirects to the generic University of Geneva astronomy home page; no file bytes or rows were downloaded.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: official attachment URL and observed redirect destination

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The project reports deprojected density, temperature, entropy, and pressure for four archival demonstration systems and states an intention to provide similar high-level products for the full sample; an intention is not a released 49-object file packet.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: official project observational-strategy text and high-level-product commitment

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The 2024 primary paper describes a 49-object X-GAP program selected with z < 0.06 and reports an actual range 0.025 < z < 0.06, differing from the legacy project page's z < 0.05 statement. It says X-GAP data will be publicly released on the project website; the article license does not establish reuse terms for each future FITS, calibration, covariance, or stellar-baryon product.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: primary article sample-selection, reported sample range, data-release, and license statements

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The current paper documents an analysis sample of 44 X-GAP groups in the 1e13-1e14 solar-mass range using the directly measured X-ray luminosity-temperature relation. It does not establish a machine-readable release of direct radial density, pressure, temperature, and stellar-baryon endpoints with their joint covariance.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: arXiv abstract, journal reference, DOI, and version history

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The current forward-model analysis publishes integrated X-GAP observables and accounts for covariance among its population summaries. That population-level covariance is not a released per-object radial likelihood covariance, and the paper does not establish a complete direct density-pressure-temperature-stellar profile packet.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: arXiv abstract, journal reference, DOI, version history, section headings, and disclosed web-find excerpt incident

authoritative_sources.observed_release: XSA documentation and access page current in 2026 audit
authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The XSA exposes observation data, ODFs, pipeline products, catalogs, and bibliographic links; archive availability does not identify the X-GAP observation set or supply the program's deprojection, stellar-baryon, and joint-covariance products.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: ESA XMM-Newton Science Archive documentation and access landing page

authoritative_sources.observed_release: EPIC calibration status 3.14 (February 2025) listed by ESA
authoritative_sources.audited_fact: ESA publishes calibration status, Current Calibration File guidance, and release notes; a future packet must freeze the exact SAS, CCF, response, background, PSF, and observation-specific calibration lineage.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: ESA XMM-Newton calibration documentation landing page and listed status revision

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: Sun et al. analyze 43 Chandra groups with kT500 0.7-2.7 keV or M500 1e13-1e14 h^-1 solar masses; all reach beyond r2500, while 23 reach or are extrapolated to r500. The paper is not a verified object-level density, temperature, pressure, stellar-baryon, and covariance release.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: arXiv abstract, journal reference, and DOI metadata

authoritative_sources.observed_release: DR1 public 2024-01-31; main catalog v1.2 announced 2026-01-12
authoritative_sources.audited_fact: eROSITA-DE DR1 publicly provides eRASS1 calibrated event lists, images, exposure and background maps, sensitivity maps, catalogs, selected bright-source products, eSASS4DR1, CALDB, and known-issue documentation for the western hemisphere.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: official eROSITA DR1 release landing page and release notices

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The official catalog page exposes a public object inventory and data model, but not the 1178-object eRASS:4 thermodynamic subset as a direct per-group endpoint packet.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: official eROSITA DR1 catalog release page and catalog metadata

authoritative_sources.audited_fact: The analysis starts from 1178 groups spanning 2.1e12-1e14 solar masses, bins them into 271 subsamples, and estimates stacked density, temperature, and entropy at characteristic radii using deeper eRASS:4 data and count-rate/scaling-relation mass estimates; these are not target-blind direct per-group endpoints.
authoritative_sources.evidence_locator: primary article abstract, methods metadata, journal reference, and DOI

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 49 X-ray/optically selected groups, 1e13 < M500 < 1e14 solar masses; legacy page says z < 0.05 while the 2024 primary says z < 0.06 and actual 0.025 < z < 0.06; unresolved before assembly
candidate_lanes.instrument_family: XMM-Newton plus SDSS/ROSAT selection and future optical/IR stellar-baryon inputs

observed_availability: The official project page documents the exact 49-object mass-matched parent sample and a named v1.1 FITS master catalog.

The legacy page states z < 0.05, whereas the 2024 primary states z < 0.06 and reports the actual range 0.025 < z < 0.06; no payload eligibility rule is chosen until the canonical manifest reconciles them.
The project reports four archival demonstration systems with deprojected density, temperature, entropy, and pressure.

Two current 2026 primary papers analyze 44 usable X-GAP systems with integrated luminosity, gas-mass, and temperature observables, but do not establish the required direct radial multi-endpoint file packet.
XMM raw and pipeline products and mission calibration documentation are public through ESA archives.
audit_details.alias_and_overlap_blocker: The 49 master rows were not opened, the legacy FITS attachment currently redirects, the legacy/primary redshift discrepancy is unresolved, canonical aliases are not frozen, and X-COP overlap cannot be evaluated without that target-blind alias inventory.
audit_details.endpoint_blocker: Current papers provide integrated observables for 44 usable systems, but no current official full-sample file bundle was verified for direct radial density, pressure, spectroscopic temperature, and BGG+satellite+diffuse stellar baryon endpoints.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: Population-summary covariance in the current forward-model analysis does not substitute for a complete per-object within-radius, cross-radius, cross-endpoint, shared-background, PSF/response, deprojection, and stellar-population covariance packet; no such packet was verified.
audit_details.calibration_blocker: Mission calibration exists, but exact observation IDs, SAS/CCF revisions, filters, flare filtering, backgrounds, ARF/RMF, PSF mixing, and deprojection provenance are not frozen per group.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: The article is CC BY and XSA observations are public, but per-file reuse terms are not bound for the legacy master FITS or any future derived thermodynamic, covariance, and stellar-baryon products.
audit_details.population_limitation: The mass range and 49-object parent count fit the CP10 domain-mapping use case, but the redshift definition and eligible count after file availability, endpoint completeness, covariance, alias, overlap, and quality gates are unresolved.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 43 Chandra groups, M500 approximately 1e13-1e14 h^-1 solar masses; 23 reach or are extrapolated to r500

observed_availability: The primary paper documents a mass-matched 43-group Chandra analysis with robust background modeling and radial thermodynamic results.
The paper distinguishes 23 systems reaching or extrapolated to r500 from the full sample.
audit_details.alias_and_overlap_blocker: No frozen machine-readable 43-object alias inventory was verified, so X-COP and X-GAP overlap remain unaudited.
audit_details.endpoint_blocker: Published tables and figures are not a verified direct per-bin density, temperature, pressure, and stellar-baryon file bundle, and some r500 values are extrapolated.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: No released full radial and cross-endpoint covariance bundle was verified.
audit_details.calibration_blocker: A historical analysis description does not freeze current observation-level CALDB, background, response, PSF, and reduction lineage for replay.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: Article access and public Chandra observations do not establish per-file reuse terms for a derived multi-endpoint packet.
audit_details.population_limitation: The 43-object sample is useful as historical metadata and a possible reduction control, but current eligible direct-endpoint and covariance counts are zero until a file-level packet is frozen.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 1178 eROSITA groups spanning 2.1e12-1e14 solar masses, analyzed in 271 stacked subsamples with eRASS:4
candidate_lanes.instrument_family: eROSITA eRASS1 selection plus deeper eRASS:4 stacked imaging and spectroscopy

observed_availability: The eRASS1 12,247-object groups-and-clusters parent catalog, DR1 event products, exposure/background maps, eSASS, CALDB, and known-issue documentation are public.
The published thermodynamic study uses 1178 groups, 271 stacks, deeper eRASS:4 observations, and average thermodynamic measurements rather than direct per-group endpoint vectors.
audit_details.alias_and_overlap_blocker: The exact 1178-subset aliases and stack membership were not frozen or reconciled against X-COP or X-GAP.
audit_details.endpoint_blocker: The reported endpoints are stack-level averages and rely on deeper eRASS:4 analysis; they are not a direct per-group density, pressure, temperature, and stellar-baryon packet.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: No public per-group full radial and cross-endpoint covariance packet was verified; a public simulation covariance does not substitute for the observational likelihood covariance.
audit_details.calibration_blocker: DR1 calibration products cannot by themselves reproduce the deeper eRASS:4 stacked analysis, and exact stack-specific background, response, PSF, and selection covariance is not frozen.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: The DR1 archive is public with acknowledgment instructions, but reuse terms and provenance for a complete joined eRASS:4 thermodynamic and stellar-baryon packet are not verified per file.
audit_details.population_limitation: The parent population is large, but the published sample extends below 1e13 solar masses, and selecting the in-range subset would require opening identity/mass rows. Its temperatures and masses are coupled to luminosity/count-rate scaling relations and cannot serve as direct target-blind endpoints.

direct_endpoint_contract.required_source: X-ray surface-brightness or emission-measure deprojection with frozen emissivity, geometry, background, PSF, and radial covariance
direct deprojected X-ray/SZ pressure or n_e(r) times kT(r) with joint posterior draws
direct_endpoint_contract.allowed_derivation: P_e = n_e kT only when density-temperature cross-covariance is preserved

direct_endpoint_contract.required_source: background-subtracted projected or deprojected spectral fits with ARF, RMF, PSF mixing, abundance model, and radial covariance
BGG, satellites, and diffuse intragroup light with membership probabilities, photometric calibration, mass-to-light or SED posterior, IMF convention, and covariance
direct_endpoint_contract.allowed_derivation: cumulative stellar baryon profile from frozen member-level light and stellar-population nuisance draws

alias_overlap_contract.xcop_overlap_reference: the already exposed X-COP development and same-release confirmation alias inventory

whole_group_split_contract.bucket_derivation: interpret the first eight SHA-256 bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer modulo 10
whole_group_split_contract.whole_group_rule: All radii, instruments, and endpoints for one canonical group remain in one split.
